# Changelog

Release notes are generated by [changesets](https://github.com/changesets/changesets)
per published package; this file only points to them.

- `@rivus/svgo` (npm package, native CLI, and the `PerfectPan/svgo` MoonBit module,
  which share one version): [`packages/svgo-mbt/CHANGELOG.md`](packages/svgo-mbt/CHANGELOG.md)

Record a user-visible change with `pnpm changeset` in its pull request; see
"Releasing" in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md). Do not edit this file or the
package changelog by hand for a release.
